mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the vowel that is produced with the vibration of the vocal cord, when the air coming from the lungs comes out not only through the mouth but also through the nose at the same time."
A nasal vowel is the vowel that is produced with the vibration of the vocal cord, when the air coming from the lungs comes out not only through the mouth but also through the nose at the same time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a speech sound produced when the air that is released from the lungs for the purpose of a speech gets out through the mouth without meeting any obstacle in the speech organs."

A vowel can be defined as a speech sound produced when the air that is released from the lungs for the purpose of a speech gets out through the mouth without meeting any obstacle in the speech organs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major element of pronunciation in French language."
Intonation is a major element of pronunciation in French language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any of the units into which a word is divided in pronunciation, containing a vowel sound and one or more consonant sounds."
A syllable is any of the units into which a word is divided in pronunciation, containing a vowel sound and one or more consonant sounds.

The principle of liaison is one of these rules and principles.

Reading is one of the basic skills language learners should aspire to acquire as he or she learns a new language.
